record.context_brief: Remove log log from discrepancy bound
record.original_question: For each dimension s >= 2 and positive integer q, let D(a_1, ..., a_s; q) be the discrepancy of the multidimensional Korobov-Hlawka sequence defined in the paper. Is the true order of min_{(a_1,...,a_s) in Z^s} D(a_1, ..., a_s; q) bounded by O_s((log q)^(s-1))? Equivalently, can the extra factor log log q in Bykovskii's bound O_s((log q)^(s-1) log log q) be removed?

evidence.quote: Bykovskii [26, 27] proved the following result. Theorem 30. For s ⩾ 2 ... min D(a1 , ..., as ; q) ≪s (log q)s−1 log log q.
A famous well-known conjecture is that min D(a1 , ..., as ; q) ≪s (log q)s−1 , that is that the factor log log q in (64) may be thrown away.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an integer $s\ge 2$. For a positive integer $q$ and a tuple $\mathbf{a}=(a_1,\dots,a_s)\in\mathbb{Z}^s$, consider the $s$-dimensional Korobov–Hlawka point set
$$P(\mathbf{a};q)=\Big\{\Big(\Big\{\tfrac{n a_1}{q}\Big\},\Big\{\tfrac{n a_2}{q}\Big\},\dots,\Big\{\tfrac{n a_s}{q}\Big\}\Big)\in[0,1)^s : n=0,1,\dots,q-1\Big\},$$
where $\{x\}$ denotes the fractional part. Define its discrepancy
$$D(a_1,\dots,a_s;q)=\sup_{B}\Big|\,\frac{\#(P(\mathbf{a};q)\cap B)}{q}-\mathrm{vol}(B)\,\Big|,$$
where the supremum is over all axis-aligned boxes $B=\prod_{i=1}^{s}[0,\beta_i)\subset[0,1)^s$.

It is known (Bykovskii) that
$$\min_{\mathbf{a}\in\mathbb{Z}^s} D(a_1,\dots,a_s;q)\;\ll_{s}\;(\log q)^{s-1}\,\log\log q.$$

Prove or disprove: for every $s\ge 2$,
$$\min_{\mathbf{a}\in\mathbb{Z}^s} D(a_1,\dots,a_s;q)\;\ll_{s}\;(\log q)^{s-1}.$$
Equivalently, can the factor $\log\log q$ be removed from Bykovskii's bound?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that the $\log\log q$ factor can be removed from Bykovskii's bound on the minimal discrepancy of Korobov–Hlawka sequences appears to remain open. Recent work (e.g., 2026 arXiv preprint on Korobov, Larcher, and Zaremba's conjecture) revisits these bounds and improves related estimates on partial quotient sums, but does not establish the conjectured bound $O_s((\log q)^{s-1})$ for the minimal discrepancy.

status_evidence.title: On some results of Korobov and Larcher and Zaremba's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Recent improvements give bounds like O(log q · √(log log q)) on related sums, improving on Korobov and Larcher, but not eliminating the log log factor in the multidimensional discrepancy conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains an active topic; the log log factor has not been removed in the multidimensional discrepancy bound.

status_evidence.title: On some open problems in Diophantine approximation (arXiv:1202.4539)
status_evidence.snippet: A famous well-known conjecture is that min D(a1,...,as;q) << (log q)^{s-1}, that is that the factor log log q in Bykovskii's bound may be thrown away.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as a famous open conjecture.
